bio: Derek is a PhD student at the Intelligent Positioning and Navigation Laboratory. He joined the laboratory as a research assistant in 2025 and is a recipient of the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme. His work contributes to reliable, low-power positioning across urban and indoor environments.
